trigger_policy: Only Write/Bash PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure; all other tools return before context/retrieval/Gate
query_policy: Unchunked current assistant ordinary content; Write content only, no Write result; Bash complete command and textual result
initial_policy: Full first user prompt before history insertion on both sides; current test prompt versus cold training first user message; no embedding instruction, no trimming or extra reference concatenation; shared RAG/SM ranking
dedup_policy: Exclude initial sources before each Top1; merge by source; exclude previously injected sources before Gate without backfill
gate_failure_policy: Record as gate_error and raise; never silently label an API failure as abstention
context_policy: Retrieval uses current interaction; Gate sees task summary, prior public activity, current interaction and candidates
evaluation_in_key_scope: Historical evaluation is excluded from the L2 implementation key. Historical error text is indexed separately for tool-return retrieval.
